title: USDA ARS Technology Center Laboratory Mechanical Set (2019)
scope: Complete ground truth for all 19 supplied USDA Agricultural Research Service Technology Center mechanical sheets: title/sheet/scale and full-page review; six strict M-601 schedules with 30 literal rows and rich secondary schedule inventories; 157 literal air-valve applications; M-803 through M-805 controller matrices with 98 cell-bounded rows plus a 19-row dual-render visual boiler-matrix transcription; BAS/network and sequences from M-801 through M-805; mapped template sensor/thermostat contexts; and explicit source limitations. The record does not invent a final panel/terminal count, city/state, global equipment multiplier, control-valve selection, or damper-actuator schedule.
reading_notes: All 19 supplied pages have a saved full-page 144 DPI Poppler visual review. Critical M-803 through M-805 matrix and sequence regions received additional visual review; literal strict cells and bounded assertions are independently checked against retained MuPDF and Poppler captures.

M-601's six strict schedule tables retain 30 marks. Rich schedule inventory records 3 fan coils, 19 fans, 13 air-valve types, 10 attenuators, 2 unit heaters, 8 air terminals, 8 tanks, 6 air devices, 2 PRVs, and all 157 east/west laboratory air-valve application rows without equating their source rows to actuator or BAS-I/O quantities.

The M-803 chiller/primary-secondary matrix has 23 dual-text-engine rows, and M-804/M-805 have 75 more. M-803's 19-row boiler matrix uses outline glyphs that are absent from both raw text captures, so it is retained as a matching-MuPDF/Poppler visual transcription rather than presented as a raw-cell assertion.

Printed controller matrix circles are preserved by their AI/DI/AO/DO category and system template. They are logical/physical matrix assignments; the sheets say virtual points are incomplete, so no final controller-card, wiring, terminal, or installed-I/O total is claimed.

The schedules and sequences have valve/damper control context, but no control-valve schedule or damper-actuator schedule publishes Cv, actuator selection/torque, signal, fail action, or a global installed quantity.

requirement_audit.finding: The owner, Technology Center project name, engineering firm, bid issue, drawing date and unknown locality are preserved as printed/source-limited metadata.
All 19 M-series supplied pages have a sheet disposition and saved full-page render; representative sequence and schedule sheet titles are bounded in metadata.
Observed 1/8 and 1/4 inch plan scales and graphic scale-bar context are recorded as view-specific; no document-wide measured scale is invented.
Every row in six strict M-601 tables is classified/anchored, while fan, FCU, terminal, tank, air-device and every air-valve-application inventory remain source-scoped supplemental identities.
Thirty strict schedule rows and their cell witnesses are retained alongside literal rich AHU/boiler/FCU/fan/pump/chiller/ice specifications and all 157 air-valve application rows.

Ninety-eight cell-bounded M-803/M-804/M-805 source rows have system-template ownership; a further 19 boiler matrix rows are independently visual-transcribed because their outline text is not raw-extractable.
The record preserves BAS/DDC/BACnet and sequencing-controller relationships plus the explicit absence of topology, panel/card/addressing and final-terminal fields.
Heating-water, chilled-water/ice, laboratory/VAV/hood-exhaust and administration/VAV/unit-heater/exhaust sequences are captured with their diagram bindings.
Sensor, thermostat and zone mappings are retained per printed controller template; absence of a building-wide device multiplier is explicit.
Location, virtual-point incompleteness, outline-text status, network details, control-valve/damper-actuator schedules and source-inventory limits are explicit.
Every supplied page has a complete full-page review finding and retained Poppler render.
Build rechecks every authored component against the two retained text engines and records source/module/render hashes; visual outline evidence cites matching two-engine renders.

page_review.finding: M-001 symbols, legends, abbreviations and general mechanical notes; defines air-valve/damper notation.
M-101 first-floor HVAC ceiling plan and laboratory supply/hood/general-exhaust air-valve context.
M-102 second-floor HVAC ceiling plan and laboratory air-valve context.
M-103 penthouse/roof HVAC plan locating AHU and exhaust equipment.
M-301 sections tying laboratory air valves, hood exhaust and AHUs.
M-501 details including air valves, coil valves and smoke-detector details.
M-504 air-handling-unit elevation and construction details.
M-601 dense equipment, air-device, air-valve, PRV, chiller and ice-storage schedules.
M-701 east/west heating-water and chilled-water/ice-storage schematics.
M-801 control diagrams for laboratory/admin AHUs, lab/hood/general exhaust, VAVs and fan coils.
M-802 laboratory/chemistry VAV and fume-hood control diagrams with sequence text.
M-803 heating-water and chilled-water/ice sequences plus boiler/chiller I/O matrices.
M-804 laboratory AHU, fume-hood/general-exhaust and fan-coil sequences plus I/O matrices.
M-805 administration AHU, VAV, unit-heater and exhaust sequences plus I/O matrices.

verification_semantics: MuPDF and Poppler independently captured all 19 supplied vector-PDF pages. Each authored strict schedule/matrix cell and bounded text witness is rechecked by both engines at build and validation time. Full-page Poppler review establishes page disposition and visible context. The one outline-glyph boiler matrix is manually transcribed only after matching visual review in both MuPDF and Poppler renders. These processes corroborate literal source content and declared bounds; they do not infer missing installed devices, panels, terminal/card quantities, valve selection, actuator selection, location, network attributes, or source multipliers.
